risk.per_trade: 2% of the coin sleeve's equity at entry (reported column: 1%)

conflict_rule: one open position per coin; a coin is free after the exec bar that closed it; same-bar signals for a flat coin: higher timeframe wins, same timeframe -> side matching the regime, then lower 'priority' value
execution: signal known at bar close; entry at next bar open + slippage, skipped if that open is through the stop or target; exits on 1h bars: open through stop -> open, stop/target touched -> that price, both in one bar -> stop; all taker; no time stop; open positions at window end marked and closed

cost_model.funding: no stored settlement history for the window; sensitivity column 0.01% of notional per 8h held

withdrawal: month end: marked equity above $10,000 withdrawn (from sleeves above $1,000 pro rata to their excess); losses carry; next month starts at min(equity, $10,000)
selection_notes: Selection followed PROTOCOL.md on validation only.

Added before the freeze, after the first validation pass: the brief's rule that a short's validation net must stand on its own. Excluded: OSE_D_faster_confirmation|SHORT|1h|RF1|X_3R, CANDLE12_V2|SHORT|1h|RF1|X_3R, CANDLE12_V2|SHORT|1h|RF1|X_NAT. No short survives.
